message.content:
This appears to be a CBP ruling on a Creatibles air dry clay car kit. As a set, the essential character is probably the toy car with clay decoration, or the modeling clay. Likely classified as a toy set under 9503.00 (toys, other). The pull-back car is a toy vehicle, and the clay is used to decorate it. GRI 3(b) set: the essential character is likely the pull-back car, so it would go under 9503.00.00 with a subheading for toy vehicles; the 2022 HTS has 9503.00.00 with statistical suffixes. Non-wheeled or wheeled toys: 9503.00.0073 "Other toys; ... Other" is the usual catch-all. There are also 9503.00.0071 (Toys, put up in sets or outfits...?) Actually, 9503.00.0073 is "Other" under "Other toys and models, ... Other." The pull-back toy car would be "Toys representing animals or non-human creatures" (0061 area) or "Other: 9503.00.0073". Alternatively, if modeling clay were the essential character, it would be 9503.00.0090? No: modeling clay is 3407.00. A kit with a toy car is likely 9503.00.0073.

{"hts_code": "9503.00.0073", "reason": "The kit is a set whose essential character is the pull-back toy car, which is decorated with the air-dry clay, so it is classified as an other toy under heading 9503 by GRI 3(b)."}
